attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10. Created a dedicated cluster CA on node1, issued server certs (CN=node1/node2/node3 with SAN) and a client cert (CN=replicator), and enforced TLS-only replication via pg_hba.conf hostssl rules with clientcert=verify-full plus an explicit hostnossl reject rule. Verified plaintext and non-CA-signed-cert connections are rejected, base-backed up both standbys over verify-full TLS, confirmed live data replication, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof of restart and full post-restart replication/data recovery.
